AM.summary: Assessed against TMDG 2019 Category E, AM peak, 11 count sites: fails Sites with GEH < 5, R² of model against counts (through the origin, centred).
notes: The same counts were used to estimate the matrix and to validate it. TMDG and TAG M3.1 expect validation against independent counts, so hold some counts back for an independent check.
On NZTA projects matrix estimation needs the peer reviewer's agreement (TMDG).
Meeting the criteria does not by itself show the model is fit for purpose (TAG M3.1 3.2.2). The model specification agreed with the peer reviewer takes precedence over these defaults.
